profile.about_text: Welcome! I’m David, a seasoned Data Scientist & Agentic AI Developer with over 8 years of experience and a track record of 180+ successful projects. My expertise lies in transforming complex business challenges into innovative solutions powered by AI and my creative problem-solving skills.

testimonials.name: Reuben Vandeventer
testimonials.quote: Our team has been using Upwork since it began, and amongst us have engaged hundreds of freelancers. David is by far the most talented freelancer we’ve ever worked with. He has the perfect balance of technical competence, ability to quickly learn new things, and creativity to design elegant solutions to complex requirements. This particular project spanned across not only python and D3 challenges but the implementation of complex mathematic methods taken from algebraic topology, graph theory, and some of the more esoteric nuances of machine learning. Our team will definitely use David again on future projects.

testimonials.name: Jake Happe
testimonials.quote: David did an outstanding job designing an AI program for me. His technical expertise was evident from day one, and he quickly grasped the requirements of the project. David was not only highly skilled but also communicative, proactive, and committed to delivering high-quality results. He kept me updated throughout the entire process and went above and beyond to ensure the final product exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend David to anyone in need of an AI solution, you won’t be disappointed!

testimonials.name: Isabel Gonzalez
testimonials.quote:
David took up a difficult and experimental initiative focusing on a highly domain specific application with verve. We were very impressed with his ability to work independently, to present findings, and to manage the research, development, and deployment pipeline end to end for a large and complex dataset. He is excellent about communicating the rationale behind his decisions in the context of data analysis, especially given the asynchronous nature of remote work.
David: Kudos! Thanks for your contribution, and we look forward to working with you again in the future!

testimonials.name: Kevin Dorry
testimonials.quote: David was a pleasure to work with. He came into a difficult situation and made the best of it!

testimonials.name: David Imrem
testimonials.quote: David has been an incredibly valuable resource to my R&D team to explore a use case that we’ve been working on for many years.  The area of focus for our use case involved algebraic topology and graph theory to be used for high-dimensional feature discovery and analysis. The process our team used with David was to guide particular math challenges that we understood from an abstract standpoint but needed a prototype that resulted in either data frames or working visuals to which we could provide additional guidance.  This process resulted in a very loosely defined framework that David had to adapt. As a data science company, we have observed in the many other data scientists that we attempted to use before David for this same project that the loose definition of requirements is counter to the typical workflow of data science and, even more broadly speaking, engineering. David proved he had the skills and abilities to help us define what requirements should be as we progressed through the project together.

testimonials.name: Alan Arnott
testimonials.quote: David is an excellent freelancer, very easy to talk to and highly efficient and engaged

testimonials.name: Aras
testimonials.quote: David was amazing to work with, he was very professional, knowledgeable and a great communicator. We will definitely hire him again.

testimonials.name: Rania Kabbara
testimonials.quote: David was very professional, helpful and very skilled! Will certainly work with him again. Highly recommended

testimonials.name: Joerg Twachtmann
testimonials.quote: David is an ambitious, conscientious and reliable partner. He incorporated his own ideas into the project, which helped us a lot as non-technicians. If we find clients who would like to work with us, we will be happy to continue working with David. Thank you very much for the trusting cooperation.

testimonials.name: Andrea Graziano
testimonials.quote: David was fantastic to work with! He was excellent at communicating with our team and making sure that every task was done to meet our deadlines. He was innovative and always had alternative ideas to offer if needed. We will definitely work with David again should another project come up.

testimonials.name: Cary Sparrow
testimonials.quote: David does outstanding work, is excellent at communicating and keeping us informed, and is a proactive thinker. He understands the objectives and not just the tasks, and is collaborative to optimize the approach he takes to best meet the objective. For this project, we tapped into his strong expertise in web scraping methods and database operations. We absolutely plan to be working with David in the future and can highly recommend.

testimonials.name: Felix Forsgren
testimonials.quote: Had a great experience working with David.

testimonials.name: Jacqueline McShan
testimonials.quote: David was essential in helping me debug and deploy my website.He is very knowledgeable and skilled with setting up projects using AWS infrastructure. David clearly communicated with me in a timely matter if there were issues or questions concerning the project. I would definitely recommend working with David and I will most likely have more jobs for him as my website continues to evolve.

testimonials.name: Rostislav Pankratov
testimonials.quote: I’m thrilled to share my positive experience working with David. His professionalism, dedication, and quality of work exceeded my expectations. Communication was clear and prompt, and he delivered exceptional results within the agreed timeframe. I highly recommend David and look forward to collaborating with him again in the future.

testimonials.name: Federico Rossi
testimonials.quote: David’s skills in production are top-notch. He’s got a real knack for bringing AI models into the real world, ensuring they perform seamlessly in live environments. His work has been key to the app’s success, making it not just functional but also reliable and efficient for everyday users. He’s a wizard at making sure everything runs smoothly, from the backend to the user interface, which speaks volumes about his expertise in production.

projects.title: AI Marketing — Tracking, SEO & GEO/AEO

outcomes: Enquiries measured: 0 of 3 routes → 3 of 3
Page weight 11.58 MB → 1.21 MB (one image 6.67 MB → 102 KB)
Indexable pages 1 → 116
Google ad click ID captured so an enquiry traces to the exact paid click
Meta description and heading/schema structure rewritten for search and AI answer engines

Automated medication-price lookup to test plan coverage
All AI and data handling built to HIPAA regulations

Video demo published

XGBoost AVM feeding profit and risk KPIs

Multi-format ingestion (PDF, CSV, HTML, plain text) with automated OCR
Shipped with deployment scripts, Docker config and README so other teams can adapt it

projects.title: Data Visualization Expert

projects.role: Architect and builder, including the toolchain decision
outcomes: Switched from Dash to D3.js when Dash could not hit the required smoothness and styling control
Video export pipeline via FFmpeg for shareable and embeddable output
Reports delivered with documented, reproducible toolchain

projects.title: Classification of Industry of Firm
projects.summary: End-to-end pipeline that infers NAICS/SIC industry codes for unlabelled New York firms by registry matching plus a BERT classifier, with GPT-4 few-shot labelling to expand coverage.

outcomes: Labelled training set built by combining registry matches with GPT-4 few-shot augmentation, avoiding manual annotation
BERT classifier chosen over SVM/Random Forest baselines, optimised for accuracy and inference cost
Random manual QA reviews of both matching and predictions
Replication package delivered so stakeholders can reproduce the whole workflow

projects.title: Gemini LangGraph LLM Agent

ABN/ACN authenticity verified against an external API
Hard-coded prompts replaced with arbitrary user-supplied questions and variables
Long contracts processed end to end via multi-agent workflow on Gemini's extended context
Ready-to-use Word review reports generated automatically

projects.title: Multilingual AI Text Generation System

Scope extended into two additional contracts

Optional KMeans clustering of similar residual patterns
Interactive visual output for analyst review

projects.title: Data Science Consulting & Review

Endpoints served recommendations from Firebase data

Full reproducible generation parameters documented

projects.title: Data Expert with R

projects.role: Sole developer across three consecutive contracts
outcomes: Production KPI algorithm for CTE medical image experts served over REST
Interactive graphs built to client spec inside the existing Vue.js app
Three consecutive contracts, each extending the previous

projects.title: AI Models (Aitana Lopez)

Daily content cadence to grow follower base

outcomes: EDA on a client-labelled set of ~30 CVs drove feature engineering and tuning
High-accuracy classifier separating high- from low-value candidates

projects.title: Build a Google Vision AI System

outcomes: Service returns top-10 visually similar products per input image as an Excel export

projects.title: Deploying ML with Python Dash

outcomes: Application hosted on EC2 with Route 53 routing to a custom domain
Documentation revised and package versions pinned for reproducible hosting

projects.title: Need to develop matching AI powered web app platform

projects.title: KPI Analysis

projects.role: Sole consultant — from KPI definition to shipped application
outcomes: KPI framework defined against the client's actual business questions
Data extracted from Meta, Google Ads, Stripe and Google Analytics
Interactive Dash app showing KPIs over time and by sector with filters

projects.title: Document OCR & data extraction

projects.role: Sole engineer — prototyping through production API
outcomes: Prototyped OCR+NLP and custom YOLO field-detection approaches; both too slow at ~10s per image
Shipped Textract + regex instead, extracting fields in under 5 seconds
Deployed as a REST API replacing manual data entry at scale for Sick.org / Curogram

projects.summary: Automated Valuation Model and broker bot for the Australian real-estate market, from data collection through to a profit-maximising evaluation algorithm.

projects.title: Entity Resolution
projects.summary: Entity resolution to deduplicate records referring to the same real-world entity across and within client datasets.

Selected and tuned the ML-based dedupe library against a labelled training set, with output analysis confirming quality

projects.title: Scrapy + BigQuery + Cloud
projects.summary: Scrapy pipeline for damaged-car listings from a site without API support, reading input URLs from BigQuery and writing results back to BigQuery tables.

projects.title: Scrapy + AWS EC2 + S3
projects.summary: Large-scale Scrapy crawler collecting millions of Indeed pages into structured S3 storage on a schedule.
outcomes: Millions of data points extracted and stored in S3 under a defined folder and naming convention
Ran on schedule from an EC2 Ubuntu instance without being blocked

projects.title: Computer Vision | IOT
projects.summary: Driver-fatigue detection from video, running on-device on Raspberry Pi 4 / Jetson Nano with real-time alarms.
projects.role: Sole engineer — research, modelling, edge deployment
outcomes: Research-led approach based on a published facial-motion-entropy fatigue algorithm
XGBoost over current and 10 previous FFT/FFV values to read head position over a 3-5 second window
Rule-based yawn and eye-closure triggers layered on top
Dockerised and deployed to Jetson Nano and Pi 4 within edge compute limits

projects.title: Stock Analysis
projects.summary: Statistical test of a client hypothesis about price co-movement between similarly named stock tickers.
outcomes: Confirmed a measurable relationship between price changes in similarly named tickers

projects.title: Algorithmic Trading in Python
projects.summary: Crypto trading bot exploiting lag on a smaller exchange, plus a bot executing signals from a custom TradingView strategy.
outcomes: Identified and traded a timezone/size-driven lag on a smaller exchange
Signal-following bot deployed against a custom TradingView strategy
Honest reported outcome: profitable at times, but trading fees and regime change mean the strategy needs constant monitoring and tuning

projects.title: LDA and LIWC Analysis of Tweets
projects.summary: LDA topic modelling and LIWC psycholinguistic analysis of Trump's Covid-era tweets.
outcomes: Interactive pyLDAvis HTML outputs of discovered topic clusters
LIWC analysis completed in Python after resolving dictionary encoding with the original author, Dr. James W. Pennebaker

projects.title: Stock Trend & Sentiment Analysis
projects.summary: Web UI analysing trending stocks against search-trend and sentiment signals, including Reddit sentiment around the GameStop episode.
outcomes: Two linked apps surfacing trend and sentiment series per ticker with correlation charts
Reddit sentiment analysed against price changes and returns for meme stocks such as GameStop

projects.title: Image Background Removal
projects.summary: U-Net background removal for apparel images, deployed as a service on AWS.
outcomes: High-quality background removal on apparel photography, deployed and demoable on EC2

projects.title: Python Cluster Analysis App

Interactive D3 force-directed graph with node selection and colouring by dimension
Export back to CSV/Excel with cluster IDs appended for downstream analysis

projects.title: AI powered Scrapy bot
projects.summary: Scrapy bot that extracts company and employee data from thousands of structurally different websites by using an LSTM model to locate the right HTML tags.
outcomes: Replaced per-site xpath rules with a learned tag-detection model, making the crawler generalise across thousands of layouts
Model deployed to the cloud in production

projects.title: Recommender System
projects.summary: Hybrid three-layer recommender system for a matchmaking website, combining client rules, collaborative filtering and an ML ensemble.
outcomes: Three-layer architecture: client rules, collaborative filtering, then an ensemble content model
Recommendations matched the pairs the company's human experts were recommending manually
